title: Autonomous recursive Driver-Engine container runtime, fast-main freedom policy, and dot-free distillation orchestrator
goal: Implement CEO Mandate 73 Section 2 recursive Driver <-> Engine container adapter (`crates/susi-harness/src/recursive.rs`, `susi-recursive-container-v1`) enabling any verified container to operate as Coordinator (Driver), Engine (worker), or both across nested waves with zero dependency on `dot`, isolated per-worker sandboxes and 5-port socket offsets, monotonic authority/scope/budget/timeout/depth attenuation, cycle detection, cooperative cancellation, idempotency ledger, and SHA-256 provenance receipts; add `IntegrationPolicy::fast_main()` (`PublicationMode::FastMainStream`) in `crates/susi-harness/src/workflow.rs` granting zero-cooldown autonomous development `main` freedom while protecting `refs/susi/*`, `release/*`, `refs/tags/v*`, foreign `local-agent/<other>` branches, and destination-first non-stub migrations; upgrade `local-distill` (`xtask/src/distill_compose.rs`) with self-contained `orchestrate`, `--tasks-from-range <A..B>`, and `submit-main` non-force object-store reconciliation; and close `T-CARBONDISTILL-1` with zero `dot` dependency.
limitations: Recursive Driver <-> Engine orchestration and `local-distill orchestrate` / `submit-main` compose and publish development streams and candidate branches without `dot` or GitHub service coupling; production `v*` release promotion still requires full exact-tree qualification gates across Linux x86_64 and Windows x86_64.
